description: Wapierz, a Slavic vampire risen from an old barrow, a tall gaunt corpse-pale man with grey-white skin and a bald head, a torn white burial shroud hanging from his shoulders, long sharp fangs, glowing red eyes, long clawed hands reaching out, standing upright, eerie and menacing, full body, three-quarter view, no grave, the creature alone, no rocks, no ground, no background, the whole creature inside the picture
